description:
No module under `crates/jit/src/commands/` imports from the output layer: commands return command or domain values, and the output layer builds responses from them.

## Background

`@/inv/architecture-dependency-direction` points dependencies inward. The output layer depending on result types that `commands/` defines is that direction; `commands/` importing `crate::output` is the reverse. At this task's filing, `commands/` modules query, graph, validate, issue, document, gate_check and worktree named `crate::output` types, mostly to build responses (`GraphTreeResponse`, `DivergenceResponse`, `StateRollup`, `IssueShowResponse`, `ArtifactDirectoryResponse` and others) or to use `ExitCode`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No module under `crates/jit/src/commands/` names any `crate::output` path; commands return command or domain values and the output layer builds responses from them.
- [hard] REQ-02: A structural test scans `commands/` for `crate::output` and fails naming each offending file.
- [hard] REQ-03: JSON payloads, schema names, human output and exit codes of every affected leaf are unchanged, and the existing suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Decisions

- D-01: Rescoped by steward ruling (just-in-time-6a, 2026-11-04), correcting the earlier output-ownership ruling. Under `@/inv/architecture-dependency-direction` the output layer depending on command-defined result types is the correct direction, so relocating registered success types into `output/` is not required; at an estimated +280 production lines it is churn without simplification. The former REQ-01 to REQ-03 (relocation, deletion of command-layer response shapes and its registration guard) are dropped, not deferred. The remaining scope is the former REQ-05 and its structural test (now REQ-01 and REQ-02) and the unchanged-output criterion (now REQ-03). Plan D-59.

## Notes

The estimate that prompted the rescope (about +120 to +500 lines, central +280) came from a read-only survey of registered success types defined outside `output/`. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Commands import nothing from the output layer
